shortDescription: Premium single-page corporate template for IT, software, and B2B businesses. Dark navy hero with a live-status dashboard signature panel, bento-grid services, industries grid, portfolio, process timeline, testimonials, and a two-field (name + phone) contact form. Sora/Manrope/IBM Plex Mono typography, Lucide icons, built with Tailwind CSS and vanilla JS. Fully responsive with glass-effect sticky nav and scroll-reveal animations.
